children: Markets held onto strong gains at midday on Monday, November 2, 2026, with the BSE Sensex trading at 75,198.92, up 739.39 points or 0.99 per cent, as of 12.55 pm, after touching an intraday high of 75,557.06 earlier in the session. The Nifty50 stood at 23,265, up 211.90 points or 0.92 per cent, having touched an intraday high of 23,360.50, with the Advance-Decline Ratio at 35:15.

The frontline indices surged to their highest levels since late September, with Nifty futures testing their 50-day EMA, according to SBI Securities. On the BSE, 2,802 stocks advanced against 1,429 declines, with 86 stocks touching 52-week highs and 179 stocks locked in the upper circuit.
Reliance Industries leads Nifty gains; energy stocks outperform

Reliance Industries remained the session’s standout performer, surging 7.36 per cent to ₹1,250.60 against a previous close of ₹1,164.90, touching an intraday high of ₹1,260, with value traded at ₹7,138.39 crore, the heaviest traded stock by value on the Nifty50.

SBI Securities noted it “emerged as the top contributor to Nifty’s gains.” Shriram Finance followed with a 5.04 per cent gain to ₹864.60, while Tata Steel rose 4.63 per cent to ₹175.36. Coal India gained 4.47 per cent to ₹406.40, and Jio Financial Services added 4.35 per cent to ₹213.40. Nifty Energy was the best-performing sectoral index of the session.

title: Nifty holds Sept highs at midday; Reliance surges 7.4%, IT stocks drag
